solution.v: Identify the roles of variables: x = fundraising tier level (input), y = total donations raised in dollars (output). The equation y = -3x - 5 is a linear model in slope-intercept form.
The slope is the coefficient of x, which is -3. The y-intercept is -5 (a separate parameter).
Slope = Δy/Δx: for every 1-unit increase in x (one additional tier level), y changes by -3 — meaning donations decrease by 3 dollars. The negative sign encodes a decrease, not an increase.
